heading: Authorization of appropriations
lead: There are authorized to be appropriated to carry out this part $33,317,000 for fiscal year 2015, $35,890,000 for fiscal year 2016, $36,635,000 for fiscal year 2017, $37,448,000 for fiscal year 2018, $38,328,000 for fiscal year 2019, and $39,141,000 for fiscal year 2020.

notes.heading: Prior Provisions
notes.text: A prior section 796l, Pub. L. 93–112, title VII, § 753, as added Pub. L. 102–569, title VII, § 703(a), Oct. 29, 1992, 106 Stat. 4468, authorized appropriations, prior to the general amendment of this subchapter by Pub. L. 105–220.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 2014—Pub. L. 113–128 substituted “$33,317,000 for fiscal year 2015, $35,890,000 for fiscal year 2016, $36,635,000 for fiscal year 2017, $37,448,000 for fiscal year 2018, $38,328,000 for fiscal year 2019, and $39,141,000 for fiscal year 2020.” for “such sums as may be necessary for each of the fiscal years 1999 through 2003.”

sourceCredit: (Pub. L. 93–112, title VII, § 753, as added Pub. L. 105–220, title IV, § 410, Aug. 7, 1998, 112 Stat. 1241; amended Pub. L. 113–128, title IV, § 488, July 22, 2014, 128 Stat. 1694.)
